calculation_handling.description: Measurement rule: required minimum ancillary building setbacks apply to all parts of an ancillary building or structure above and below ground, excluding footings.
calculation_handling.gaps: Inclusion rule for setback measurement; no DSL variable defined.

units.disclosure: none

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.10(1), a ground-mounted heating or air-conditioning device may be located in a front yard if it is at least 6.0 metres from the front lot line.
calculation_handling.gaps: The subject (a ground-mounted heating or air-conditioning device) has no vocab building type or use token; the 6.0 m distance from the front lot line is a placement condition on the device with no DSL variable.

units.disclosure: A ground-mounted heating or air-conditioning unit may sit in the front yard if at least 6.0 m from the front lot line; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(3)(A), a ground-mounted heating or air-conditioning device may be in a side yard if it is no closer to the side lot line than the lesser of 0.9 m or the required minimum side yard setback for the residential building on the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: Subject device has no vocab token; side_setback_m in the expression is the residential building's required side setback. Keyed to lot_line_setback_m because it is a distance from the side lot line for a device, not the building's side yard.

units.disclosure: A ground-mounted heating or air-conditioning unit in a side yard must be at least 0.9 m (or the house's side setback, if less) from the side lot line; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(2) and (3), an open platform (at least 50% of its exterior sides above the floor open, and no closer than 0.3 m to the residential building) has a minimum rear and side yard setback equal to the greater of (A) 0.3 m or (B) its floor height above the ground; this unit carries the 0.3 m argument.
calculation_handling.gaps: The other greater-of argument is unit (11)(B). Mixed targets (rear and side) in one unit. The 50% openness and the stem's 0.3 m separation-from-building qualifier are not expressible conditions.

units.disclosure: Open decks must be set back from the rear and side lot lines by at least 0.3 m or their floor height, whichever is greater; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: The second greater-of argument for an open platform's minimum rear and side yard setback: a distance equal to the highest vertical distance between any part of the platform floor and the ground below it.
calculation_handling.gaps: The platform floor height above the ground below it has no licensed DSL variable (proposed_height_m / platform_height_m are not licensed by this text), so no expression is written. Applies to both rear and side setbacks.

units.disclosure: Open decks must be set back from the rear and side lot lines by at least their floor height above the ground, if more than 0.3 m; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: On a through lot where a residential building on an adjacent lot fronts on the street abutting the rear lot line, an ancillary building's minimum rear yard setback equals the required minimum front yard setback for the residential building on the adjacent lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: The value is the adjacent lot's required front yard setback, which has no DSL variable (abutting_front_setback_m is the actual setback and is not licensed by this text), so no numeric expression could be written. The adjacent-lot-fronts-rear-street condition has no vocab token.

units.disclosure: On a through lot, a shed or garage must be set back from the rear street as far as the neighbour's required front setback; not evaluated.

condition.if: lot_depth_m > 45 m and proposed_height_m > 2.5 m or lot_depth_m > 45 m and interior_floor_area_m2 > 10 m2

calculation_handling.description: On a lot deeper than 45 m, an ancillary building taller than 2.5 m or with floor area over 10 square metres has a minimum rear yard setback equal to half its height.
calculation_handling.gaps: 'half' is written as 0.5 ratio (word numeral). The floor-area test uses interior_floor_area_m2 (a target used as a variable) for 'floor area'; no floor-area band token exists. Ancillary building height and floor area are scenario values. Subject to 10.5.60.20(5).

units.disclosure: Larger sheds or garages on deep lots must be set back from the rear lot line by half their height; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: In cases other than (2)(A) and (2)(B), the minimum rear yard setback for ancillary buildings or structures is 0.3 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: 'Other cases' is the residual of (A) and (B); the residual cannot be written as a condition, so condition is none. Subject to 10.5.60.20(5).

units.disclosure: Sheds and other ancillary buildings generally need a 0.3 m rear setback; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: An ancillary building or structure in a side yard has the same minimum side yard setback as the residential building on the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: The value is the residential building's own side_setback_m; writing side_setback_m = side_setback_m on the same target is circular, so no expression is written. Subject to 10.5.60.20(6) and (7).

units.disclosure: A shed or garage in a side yard needs the same side setback as the house; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: An ancillary building in a rear yard and less than 1.8 m from the residential building has the same minimum side yard setback as the residential building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Value equals the residential building's side_setback_m (same target, circular), so no expression; the rear-yard location is a placement input.

units.disclosure: A shed close to the house (under 1.8 m) in the rear yard needs the house's side setback; not evaluated.

numeric_expression: side_setback_m = if(required_lot_frontage_m ≥ 21.0 m and proposed_height_m > 2.5 m or required_lot_frontage_m ≥ 21.0 m and interior_floor_area_m2 > 10 m2; 0.5 ratio × proposed_height_m; 0.3 m) @(3)(C)

calculation_handling.description: An ancillary building in a rear yard and 1.8 m or more from the residential building: (i) on a corner lot where an adjacent residential building fronts the flanking street, set back from that street side lot line by the adjacent building's required front yard setback; (ii) on a lot with required minimum lot frontage of 21.0 m or more, if taller than 2.5 m or over 10 square metres floor area, a side setback of half its height; (iii) otherwise 0.3 m.
calculation_handling.gaps: Arm (i) (corner lot, adjacent lot fronting the flanking street; value is the adjacent building's required front setback) has no DSL variable and is not expressed. 'half' written as 0.5 ratio; floor area read as interior_floor_area_m2.

units.disclosure: Sheds farther than 1.8 m from the house generally need a 0.3 m side setback, or half their height for larger ones on wide lots; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(2), (3) and (5) to (11), an ancillary building or structure may be no closer than 2.5 metres from the original centreline of a lane.
calculation_handling.gaps: Measured from the original lane centreline, not the lot line; lane_setback_m is measured from the lot line, so evaluation needs the lane's original width, which we do not hold.

units.disclosure: Sheds and garages must stay at least 2.5 m from the original centreline of a lane; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: An ancillary building containing a parking space, where the rear lot line abuts a lane and vehicle access is from the lane, has a minimum rear yard setback of 1.0 metres, subject to 10.5.60.20(4).
calculation_handling.gaps: Vehicle access from the lane is a design input with no separate token.

units.disclosure: A rear garage entered from a lane needs a 1.0 m rear setback (and 2.5 m from the lane centreline); not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: An ancillary building containing a parking space on a through lot with vehicle access from the street abutting the rear lot line has a minimum rear yard setback of the greater of the adjacent lot's required front yard setback or 6.0 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: Arm (i), the adjacent lot's required front yard setback, has no DSL variable, so only the 6.0 m arm is expressed (a lower bound of the true max).

units.disclosure: A garage on a through lot entered from the rear street needs at least 6.0 m rear setback, or the neighbour's front setback if larger; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: An ancillary building containing a parking space, where a side lot line abuts a lane and vehicle access is from the lane, has a minimum building setback of 1.0 metres from that side lot line, subject to 10.5.60.20(4).
calculation_handling.gaps: Keyed to lane_setback_m (setback from a lot line abutting a lane). Vehicle access from the lane is a design input.

units.disclosure: A garage entered from a lane along the side needs a 1.0 m setback from that side lot line; not evaluated.

evidence.garage_entrance_faces_street: vehicle access is from the street

calculation_handling.description: An ancillary building containing a parking space on a corner lot with vehicle access from the street abutting the side lot line has a minimum side yard setback of 6.0 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: Read as the setback from the side lot line abutting the street (side_setback_street_m). Vehicle access from the flanking street is a design input (garage_entrance_faces_street, kept out of the condition because it is a design choice).

units.disclosure: A garage on a corner lot entered from the side street needs a 6.0 m setback; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(3) and (6), an ancillary building containing parking spaces for dwelling units on abutting lots may be located on the common side lot line.
calculation_handling.gaps: A shared garage straddling two lots is a design choice we do not model.

units.disclosure: A garage shared with the neighbouring lot may sit on the common side lot line; not evaluated.

evidence.semi_detached_house: residential building other than an apartment building
evidence.detached_houseplex: residential building other than an apartment building
evidence.semi_detached_houseplex: residential building other than an apartment building
evidence.townhouse: residential building other than an apartment building

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(2), on a lot with a residential building other than an apartment building, an outdoor pool or other water structure has a minimum rear yard setback of 25.0 m on a through lot where an adjacent lot fronts the rear street, 3.0 m on a corner lot where an adjacent lot fronts the flanking street, 1.2 m otherwise, and none if the water surface area is 1.0 square metres or less.
calculation_handling.gaps: The arms are selected by through_lot / corner_lot plus adjacent-lot frontage, which an expression cannot test, so the three values are listed per arm and must not be applied together. The 1.0 m2 water-area exemption has no DSL variable. 'Other than an apartment building' is keyed as the non-apartment residential types.

units.disclosure: Pools need a rear setback of 1.2 m, or more on through and corner lots; tiny water features (1 m2 or less) are exempt; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(2), on a lot with an apartment building an outdoor pool or water structure has a minimum rear yard setback of 7.5 m on a through lot, 4.5 m otherwise, and none if the water surface area is 3.0 square metres or less.
calculation_handling.gaps: Arms selected by through_lot are listed per arm (not to be applied together); the water-area exemption has no DSL variable.

units.disclosure: Pools on apartment lots need a 4.5 m rear setback (7.5 m on through lots); not evaluated.

evidence.detached_houseplex: residential building other than an apartment building

evidence.townhouse: residential building other than an apartment building

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(3), on a lot with a residential building other than an apartment building, a pool or water structure has a minimum side yard setback of the greater of 1.2 m or the side setback required by 10.5.60.20(3); on a corner lot, the residential building's required side yard setback plus 1.5 m from the side lot line abutting a street; none if the water surface area is 1.0 square metres or less.
calculation_handling.gaps: Arm (i) is max(1.2 m; the 10.5.60.20(3) ancillary side setback), whose second argument has no DSL variable, so only 1.2 m is expressed. Arm (ii) applies only on a corner_lot, which a unit-wide condition cannot scope to that statement. Water-area exemption has no DSL variable.

units.disclosure: Pools need at least 1.2 m side setback, more on the street side of a corner lot; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(3), on a lot with an apartment building a pool or water structure has a minimum side yard setback of 4.5 m, 7.5 m from a side lot line abutting a street on a corner lot, and none if the water surface area is 3.0 square metres or less.
calculation_handling.gaps: The corner-lot arm is a different target and applies only on a corner_lot; the water-area exemption has no DSL variable.

units.disclosure: Pools on apartment lots need a 4.5 m side setback (7.5 m on the street side of a corner lot); not evaluated.

10.5.60.20(1).explanation: Setbacks for sheds, garages and other ancillary structures are measured to every part of the structure above and below ground, except footings.

10.5.60.20(10).explanation: A ground-mounted heating or air-conditioning unit may be in the front yard if at least 6.0 m from the front lot line, and in a side yard if at least 0.9 m (or the house's side setback, if less) from the side lot line.

10.5.60.20(11).explanation: An open deck or platform must be set back from the rear and side lot lines by at least 0.3 m, or by its floor height above the ground if that is greater.

10.5.60.20(2).explanation: Rear setback for sheds and other ancillary buildings: usually 0.3 m; half the building's height for larger ones on lots deeper than 45 m; and the neighbour's front setback on a through lot facing a street at the back.

10.5.60.20(3).explanation: Side setback for sheds and other ancillary buildings: the house's side setback if in a side yard or within 1.8 m of the house; otherwise usually 0.3 m, more for larger buildings on wide lots or along a corner lot's side street.

10.5.60.20(4).explanation: Sheds and garages must stay at least 2.5 m from the original centreline of a lane.

10.5.60.20(5).explanation: A detached garage entered from a rear lane needs a 1.0 m rear setback; one on a through lot entered from the rear street needs at least 6.0 m or the neighbour's front setback.

10.5.60.20(6).explanation: A detached garage entered from a lane along the side needs 1.0 m from that side lot line; on a corner lot entered from the side street it needs 6.0 m.

10.5.60.20(7).explanation: A garage shared by two neighbouring lots may be built on the common side lot line.

10.5.60.20(8).explanation: Pools and ponds need a rear setback of 1.2 m (4.5 m on apartment lots), more on through and corner lots; very small water features are exempt.

10.5.60.20(9).explanation: Pools and ponds need a side setback of at least 1.2 m (4.5 m on apartment lots), more on the street side of a corner lot; very small water features are exempt.
